mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for exterior stucco repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our stucco repair process begins with a thorough inspection to identify the extent of the damage. We then carefully remove any loose or compromised stucco, clean the underlying surface, and apply a high-quality bonding agent. Next, we apply new stucco in layers, matching the existing texture and color as closely as possible for a seamless finish. Finally, the repaired area is allowed to cure properly, often followed by a sealant application for enhanced durability and weather resistance, restoring the beauty and protection of your home's exterior.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves inspecting damage, removing compromised stucco, preparing the surface, applying new stucco to match texture, and ensuring proper curing and sealing.
